name: Very Merrytime Creamy Winter Squash Soup with Creole Lobster
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
whyItWorks: Velvety puréed winter squash soup topped with tender poached lobster medallions offers soluble fiber and lean seafood protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the lobster medallions plain on top (without spicy Creole seasoning dust) and take a Lactaid for the cream base.
watchOuts: Creole seasoning on the lobster garnish
Dairy cream in the squash purée
